resources.string: Find and remove the app that is showing pop-ups
Hold both volume buttons for 3 seconds to see which apps are causing pop-ups and slowing the phone, and remove them.
Which app is troubling your phone?
Newest apps are at the top. Red ones are the most likely problem.
No downloaded apps found. Your phone looks clean.
Some checks are off. Ask your helper to finish setup in Swatter.
Was open in the last 15 minutes
Do these steps once on the owner\'s phone. After that, the owner just holds both volume buttons for 3 seconds when pop-ups appear.
1. Allow \"Usage access\" for Swatter, so it can tell which app was open when ads appeared.
2. Turn on the volume button shortcut: in Accessibility, open \"Swatter: fix my phone\" and switch on its shortcut. Choose \"Hold volume keys\" if asked.
2. This phone is older than Android 11, so the volume shortcut is not available. Use the Swatter icon instead.
3. Test it: hold both volume buttons for 3 seconds, or tap below.
